content: {"episode_id":"ep-05159","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT 93229, denied under CO-197 because required prior authorization was not obtained. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and dizziness consistent with a history of supraventricular tachycardia in the context of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery. Monitoring was ordered to evaluate the frequency and hemodynamic impact of these arrhythmic events and correlate them with the patient's giddiness."}
